_README: MAINNET authority assignment for Dominion SILV. This file is the published record of which
address holds which power over the protocol.
These are PUBLIC KEYS. Publishing them is safe, they are on chain regardless, and it is the point:
anyone can check that the deployed program's authorities match what was announced. Verify with
scripts/verify-mainnet-authorities.ts. No secret material belongs in this file, ever.

ops_admin.role: config.admin. Day-to-day operations: premint, param setters, proposing timelocked actions.
ops_admin.kind: off-curve (PDA, consistent with a Squads vault)

upgrade_authority.role: BPF loader upgrade authority. Can replace the program with arbitrary code, which overrides EVERY in-program safeguard. The ultimate trust root.
upgrade_authority.kind: off-curve (PDA, consistent with a Squads vault)

compliance.role: SILV mint freeze_authority AND Token-2022 permanent delegate. Can freeze/thaw any holder and transfer or burn any holder's tokens. Set at MINT CREATION and permanent.
compliance.kind: off-curve (PDA, consistent with a Squads vault)

guardian.role: Guardian veto: pause, cancel_timelocked_action, cancel_admin_transfer during a delay window.
guardian.kind: off-curve (PDA, consistent with a Squads vault)

inventory_wallet.role: config.inventory_wallet. Destination of admin_premint. Holds the pre-minted SILV behind 3-of-5 before an operational tranche is moved out.
inventory_wallet.kind: OFF-CURVE (the ops Squads vault). SAME ADDRESS AS ops_admin, deliberately.

inventory_transit_wallet.role: NOT a program field. The hot wallet that receives operational tranches out of the inventory vault and creates the LP or settles OTC. Was config.inventory_wallet until 2026-08-12.

ops_squads_multisig.role: The Squads MULTISIG account whose vault index 0 IS ops_admin (65g5nNX...). This is the value for NEXT_PUBLIC_OPS_SQUADS. NOT interchangeable with ops_admin.

upgrade_squads_multisig.role: The Squads MULTISIG account whose vault index 0 is the upgrade authority AND the compliance vault (FqFNX...). Value for NEXT_PUBLIC_UPGRADE_SQUADS.

fee_exempt_at_launch.role: To be fee-exempted on BOTH sides (flags 3 = mint + redeem) at launch, per the owner 2026-08-12.

deployer.role: Paid for the mainnet deploy and signed initialize. Must be the upgrade authority at initialize time, so either deploy from the upgrade vault or transfer the authority to it afterwards.

mint_creation_ceremony.mint_authority: the program's silv_mint_authority PDA (derived, never a wallet)
mint_creation_ceremony.name: Dominion Silver

launch_posture.max_silv_supply: 150000000000 atomic (150,000 oz at 6 decimals). Tighten-only: lowering it makes the lower value the new permanent ceiling.
launch_posture._source_of_truth: Mutable settings (pause flags, premiums) live on chain and are NOT duplicated here. Read them from ConfigAccount.

release_artifact.toolchain: solana-cli/SBF 3.0.0, platform-tools v1.51, SBF rustc 1.84.1, anchor-cli 0.31.1
